question_en: Set the microscope camera exposure time to 20 ms.
setup: The instrument does not keep the camera exposure in a Python attribute (StreamingTUCam.set_exposure goes straight to the SDK), so there is no read-back path. Grade by the tool call argument (ms=20) or drop the item.
todo_from_sheet: No read-back path on the instrument: StreamingTUCam.set_exposure goes straight to the SDK without keeping the value in an attribute, and hardware_snapshot has no camera entry. Grade by the tool call argument or drop the item.
